methodologyNotes: 13 notable air fryers selected as the 2026 buyer comparison set. Seeds from the brief were verified and supplemented: Ninja AF141 (Air Fryer Pro 4-in-1) and Ninja DZ201 (Foodi DualZone) confirmed as current US SKUs; Ninja Foodi XL Pro DT201 (countertop oven) added as a widely-compared adjacent product. Cosori Pro II (CP158-AF) is discontinued; included as widely reviewed/compared unit with price from last retail. Cosori Dual Blaze (CS268-AF) confirmed. Cosori TurboBlaze 6qt and Cosori Iconic added as current 2024-2025 flagship replacements. Philips Airfryer XXL HD9650/96 confirmed (now discontinued but widely reviewed). Instant Vortex Plus 6qt confirmed. Dreo ChefMaker confirmed. Typhur Dome 2 (AF03, January 2025) chosen over original Dome as the in-market current model with verified specs. Our Place Wonder Oven confirmed. Breville Smart Oven Air Fryer Pro BOV900BSS confirmed. Primary sources: manufacturer product pages (sharkninja.com, cosori.com, dreo.com, typhur.com, fromourplace.com, breville.com, usa.philips.com, instantpot.com). Fallbacks: Amazon product listings, VeSync store (Cosori official), Philips USA product page, ManualsLib (Breville BOV900 instruction manual for max temp 480F). Corroboration: review sites, camelcamelcamel, slickdeals, and search result aggregates. specKeys chosen for real comparability across basket, dual-basket, and oven-style air fryers: capacity_qt (numeric, total usable quarts; dual-basket models list combined), type (string: basket | dual-basket | oven-style | combi), max_temp_f (numeric, maximum temperature in Fahrenheit), presets (numeric, number of one-touch cooking programs/presets on the device), dishwasher_safe (bool, whether cooking basket/drawer is dishwasher safe per manufacturer), wattage (numeric, rated watts), drawers (numeric, number of cooking chambers/baskets), release (YYYY-MM or YYYY). priceUsd = US MSRP or starting/launch price. accessedAt 2026-06-15 on all entries.

products.name: Ninja Air Fryer Pro 4-in-1 (AF141)
products.priceNote: US MSRP $89.99 (reduced from $129.99) per SharkNinja.com product page (AF141). Frequently promoted at this price.
products.provenance: SharkNinja.com product page (AF141) fetched directly: confirms 5 QT capacity, 1750W, 400°F max temp, 4 functions (Air Fry, Roast, Reheat, Dehydrate), $89.99 price. Amazon listing confirms same specs in product title (1750 Watts, 400°F Max Temp). Nonstick basket and crisper plate are dishwasher safe per product description. CamelCamelCamel confirms B0CSZ7WBYW ASIN. Functions count is 4 (no additional one-touch presets beyond the 4 modes). Release year 2023 per Amazon listing date and retailer availability.

products.name: Ninja Foodi 6-in-1 DualZone Air Fryer (DZ201)
products.priceNote: US MSRP approximately $159.99–$169.99 at major retailers; launch price was higher (~$220+). Current list price from Walmart and Amazon listings as of 2025.
products.provenance: Amazon listing (B089TQWJKK) confirms: 8 qt, 2 independent frying baskets, 6-in-1 (Air Fry, Air Broil, Roast, Bake, Reheat, Dehydrate), DualZone Technology (Match Cook + Smart Finish), dishwasher-safe baskets and crisper plates. ManualsLib/manua.ls user manual confirms 1760W power (also reported as 1700W in some retailer specs — 1760W from manual is authoritative). Temperature range per search aggregates: 105°F–450°F. Drawers: 2 independent baskets. ASIN tracking on CamelCamelCamel confirms 2021 availability. Release 2021 per Amazon listing date.

products.name: Ninja Foodi XL Pro Air Fry Oven (DT201)
products.priceNote: US MSRP approximately $249.99–$279.99 at major US retailers (Staples listed $379.99 but widely available lower). Original launch price ~$249. Commonly sold at $199–$249 range.
products.provenance: Amazon listing (B08BXX69K4) and multiple retailer pages confirm: 10-in-1 (Air Fry, Whole Roast, Air Roast, Bake, Dehydrate, Pizza, Bagel, Toast, Broil, Reheat), 1800W, Stainless Steel. Tom's Guide and Staples confirm 8-qt interior, 1800W. Temperature range 105°F–450°F from reviewer data (shouldit.com). Oven-style countertop form factor (flip-up design). Dishwasher safe for sheet pans: manufacturer guidance notes crumb tray removable but accessories not confirmed dishwasher-safe — marked null. Ninja DT201 released November 2020 per Amazon first-availability data. Drawers: 1 (oven-style single compartment).

products.name: Cosori Pro II Smart Air Fryer 5.8qt (CP158-AF)
products.priceNote: US MSRP $99.99 at launch; last retail price ~$99.99–$124.99 before discontinuation. Model CP158-AF is discontinued. VeSync store showed $124.99 at last listing.
products.provenance: VeSync official store (Cosori parent brand) confirms CP158-AF: 5.8 qt, $124.99 (sold out/discontinued). Walmart and Target listings confirm 1700W, 12-in-1 presets, dishwasher-safe basket, max temp 400°F per multiple retailer spec sheets. Target listing title explicitly states '1700W Electric Fryer, Dishwasher-Safe Parts'. 12 functions (not 13 — the 13-function variant is the Pro Gen 2 successor). Release 2021 per retailer listing dates and ASIN creation. Now discontinued, succeeded by Pro Gen 2 / TurboBlaze.

products.name: Cosori Dual Blaze 6.8qt Smart Air Fryer
products.priceNote: Current US MSRP $129.00 per Cosori.com (marked as sold out/limited); $179.99 was original launch price. VeSync store confirms $179.99 MSRP at launch (2022). Using $129.99 as current listed price.
products.provenance: VeSync official store confirms: model CAF-P583S-KUS, 6.8 qt, $179.99, 12 customizable functions (Chicken, Steak, Seafood, Veggies, Fries, Frozen, Air Fry, Reheat, Broil, Roast, Bake, Keep Warm), 360 ThermoIQ Technology with dual heating elements. Cosori.com official product page (CAF-P583S-KUS) confirms Rated Power 1750W, temperature range 175°–400°F (max 400°F), dishwasher-safe basket; rtings model page also lists 1750W. (Some third-party reviews/retailer sheets cite 1700W; manufacturer 1750W is authoritative.) Walmart listings confirm same specs. Cosori.com collection listing confirms $129.00 current price. Dual heating elements (top + bottom) distinguishing feature. Release 2022 confirmed by Gadgeteer review date and Walmart listing.

products.name: Cosori TurboBlaze 6.0qt Air Fryer
products.priceNote: US MSRP $119.99; regular sale price $99.99 per Cosori.com. Frequently available at $89–$99 at Amazon and other retailers.
products.provenance: Cosori.com product page (CAF-DC601-KUS) fetched directly: 6 qt, 1725W, 90°–450°F, 9 cooking functions (Air Fry, Roast, Bake, Broil, Dehydrate, Frozen, Proof, Reheat, Keep Warm), PFAS-free ceramic-coated basket dishwasher-safe, $99.99 sale (regular $119.99). Amazon listings confirm same specs. DC motor with 5 fan speeds noted as key differentiator. Reviewed as 46% faster than Pro Gen 2. Release 2023 per retailer availability and Amazon listing date.

products.name: Cosori Iconic Stainless Steel 6.5qt Smart Air Fryer
products.priceNote: US MSRP $249.00 per Cosori.com product page. Flagship premium model with stainless steel exterior.
products.provenance: Cosori.com product page (CAF-SE601S-CUS) fetched directly: 6.5 qt (6.2 L), 1725W, 90°–450°F, 6 functions (Air Fry, Roast, Bake, Dehydrate, Proof, Reheat), PFAS-free ceramic-coated nonstick basket and crisper plate dishwasher-safe, $249.00, 5-year warranty, 120V 60Hz. Amazon listing (B0FJYK886N) confirms all specs in product title: 'PFAS-Free Ceramic Coating, Max 450°F, Consistent Cooking, Dishwasher-Safe Basket'. Stainless steel exterior, DC motor with quiet 5 fan speeds, WiFi/app (VeSync) control. Release 2024 per Amazon listing date and Cosori flagship positioning.

products.name: Philips Premium Airfryer XXL (HD9650/96)
products.priceNote: US MSRP ~$189.99 per Walmart listing. Product is discontinued on Philips USA direct (shows 'no longer available') but remains available at retailers. Original launch price was ~$299.95.
products.provenance: Philips USA product page fetched directly: 7.3L capacity (7 qt / 3 lb), 1725W (not 1750W per some listings — Philips spec sheet says 1725W), max 200°C (392°F), 5 preset programs (frozen fries, meat, fish, whole chicken, chicken drumsticks), basket and drawer dishwasher-safe (non-stick coating confirmed), product now discontinued. Amazon listing (B07G3V9K17) title confirms: 'Fat Removal Technology, 3lb/7qt, 5 Cooking Presets'. Walmart shows $189.99. CamelCamelCamel confirms ASIN tracking from 2019 era. Twin TurboStar and Fat Removal Technology are key differentiators.

products.name: Instant Vortex Plus 6qt Air Fryer 6-in-1
products.priceNote: US MSRP approximately $99.95 at launch (2019-2020); current price $79.99–$89.99 at Amazon and Walmart. Using current retail price as representative.
products.provenance: Instant Pot official product page fetched directly: 6 qt, 1700W, 95°–400°F (max 400°F), 6 functions (Air Fry, Bake, Roast, Broil, Dehydrate, Reheat), basket top-rack dishwasher safe, EvenCrisp Technology, 120V 60Hz ETL Certified, SKU 140-3006-01. Amazon listing (B07VHFMZHJ) confirms '6-in-1, Air Fry, Broil, Dehydrate, Crisp, Roast, Reheat, Bake, Dishwasher-Safe Airfryer basket'. CamelCamelCamel tracking began September 2019 (original release); 2020 reflects wider retail availability date. Model has had multiple ClearCook variants but this is the base Vortex Plus 6qt.

products.name: Dreo ChefMaker Combi Fryer
products.priceNote: US MSRP $359.00 per Dreo.com product page. Launched via Kickstarter May 2023 then moved to retail.
products.provenance: Dreo.com product page fetched directly: 6 QT, 1800W, 100°F–450°F max temp, 40+ ingredient cooking programs in Chef Mode (44+ cited in reviews), 8 classic cooking methods in Classic Mode plus Probe Cook mode = 3 professional cooking modes total. Dishwasher-safe: cooking tray, grilling rack, and non-stick basket confirmed dishwasher safe per DR-KCM001S ManualsLib user guide. $359.00 price from dreo.com. Water atomizer (6.07 oz / 200ml tank) and cook probe included. Amazon listing confirms 'Smart Air Fryer Cooker with Cook probe, Water Atomizer, 3 professional cooking modes, 6 QT'. Type classified as 'combi' (combi-fryer with steam/water atomization). presets field shows 44 (Chef Mode ingredient programs) as the most cited headline figure per multiple review sources. Kickstarter debut May 2023.

products.name: Typhur Dome 2 AI Smart Air Fryer (AF03)
products.priceNote: US launch price $499.00 per Typhur.com; also sold at Home Depot at $449.99 after $50 promotion. Using Typhur.com launch MSRP.
products.provenance: Multiple sources confirm Typhur Dome 2 (AF03): 5.6 qt capacity, 1750W, 105°F–450°F, 15-in-1 preset modes (Pizza, Bacon, Steak, Wings, Fries, Frozen, Air Fry, Toast, Grill, Bake, Griddle, Roast, Broil, Dehydrate, Reheat), PFAS-free ceramic basket dishwasher-safe, self-cleaning cycle, dual heating elements (top + bottom), 55dB low noise. Amazon listing (B0CKP6Y6KB) confirms '15-in-1 Large Flat Airfryer with Top & Bottom Heating, Self-Cleaning Digital Fryer, PFAS-Free Ceramic Basket'. Home Depot listing (SKU AF03) confirms 5.6 qt, dishwasher safe. Launch date January 15, 2025 per Typhur announcement and multiple review sites. $499 launch price per Typhur.com and review coverage.

products.name: Our Place Wonder Oven 6-in-1
products.priceNote: US MSRP $195.00 per fromourplace.com; frequently discounted to $128–$145 at Amazon. Amazon listing (B0CLTK2JF8) shows as the standard 13 QT model.
products.provenance: Our Place product page fetched directly: 13 qt capacity, 1400W, 200°–450°F (max 450°F), 6 cooking modes (Air Fry, Bake, Toast, Roast, Reheat, Broil), steam-infusion technology, PFAS-free non-toxic materials, stainless steel exterior, 120V. Dishwasher safe: per Our Place official guidance, accessories (wire rack, bake pan, air fryer basket, crumb tray) are NOT dishwasher safe — hand-wash only; consistent across multiple review sources (mindbodydad.com, jazz-leaf.com). Wonder Oven Pro has dishwasher-safe parts but this is the standard model. MSRP $195 confirmed by Kitchn restock coverage (October 2023) and Amazon price history. Amazon listing (B0CLTK2JF8) confirms '6-in-1 Stainless Steel Air Fryer Toaster Oven Combo, 13 QT Countertop Capacity, Toast, Roast, Bake, Reheat, Broil & Steam'. Release 2023.

products.name: Breville Smart Oven Air Fryer Pro (BOV900BSS)
products.priceNote: Current US price $319.95 (marked down from $399.95) per Breville.com product page. Original launch MSRP ~$399.95. CamelCamelCamel first tracked February 2017.
products.provenance: Breville.com product page fetched directly: 1 cubic foot interior (no qt equivalent published by Breville — capacity_qt is null; 1 cu ft ≈ 29.9 L but Breville does not convert to qt), $319.95 price, 13 cooking functions (Toast 9 slices, Bagel, Broil, Bake, Roast, Warm, Pizza, Proof, Airfry, Reheat, Cookies, Slow Cook, Dehydrate). 6 independent quartz heating elements with Element IQ. ManualsLib BOV900 instruction manual confirms max temp 480°F/250°C for bake/roast/airfry functions, 1800W per AJMadison spec sheet (confirmed by multiple review sources). Breville BOV900 instruction manual (ManualsLib) explicitly states accessories 'not recommended for dishwasher' — dishwasher_safe = false. CamelCamelCamel (B01N5UPTZS) first tracked February 11, 2017 — release 2017. capacity_qt null: Breville publishes 1 cu ft, not quarts.
